item.title: You Better Believe Mumford & Sons Brought Jason Sudeikis on Stage to Sing the ‘Ted Lasso’ Theme With Them
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host speaks]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard! We've got an exciting story for you today. You know the Apple TV series Ted Lasso? Well, its star and co-creator, Jason Sudeikis, just made a surprise appearance on stage with Mumford & Sons at Madison Square Garden.
[Short music clip from Mumford & Sons plays]
Host: "It happened during the band's rendition of the Ted Lasso theme song, which was co-written by Marcus Mumford and composer Tom Howe. Sudeikis was spotted in the audience, nodding his head to the music, before suddenly sprinting on stage to join the band.
[Short sound clip of crowd cheering]
Host: "The crowd went wild as Sudeikis ran around the stage, slapping keyboard player Ben Lovett on the butt and singing along with Marcus Mumford. It was a truly unforgettable moment. And it's not the first time Sudeikis has made a surprise appearance - he also popped up at the 2026 FIFA World Cup final halftime show last month.
[Short music clip from Mumford & Sons continues to play]
Host: "The Ted Lasso theme song is all about unexpected joy, and that's exactly what Sudeikis brought to the stage that night. The performance ended with a big hug between Sudeikis and Mumford, and the crowd loved every minute of it.
[Music fades out, and the host speaks]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
